messages:
Asha Patel: Hey team :wave: kickoff for VentureX onboarding. Quick sync to align stakeholders, success criteria, and first 30-day milestones. I put a rough plan below — pls confirm owners and any risks.

Asha Patel: Proposed success criteria (suggest edits):
- API integration in staging + smoke tests passing
- End-to-end response latency p95 < 250ms for demo traffic
- Two enablement sessions recorded and shared with support
- Security checklist & basic pen-test signoff

Asha Patel: Proposed timeline (days from kickoff):
1) Day 0-5: discovery + infra checklist
2) Day 6-14: API integration + auth (OAuth + API keys)
3) Day 15-21: run pilot traffic, tune batching/kv cache
4) Day 22-30: full demo + handoff to support & CS ops

Miguel Torres: I can own enablement sessions (recording + deck). Planning two 60m sessions: internal SE + customer-facing. Target dates: week of Apr 8 and Apr 15. :ok_hand:

Priya Nair: I'll take data contract + security checklist. Need vendor contacts for their infra team. @Samir can you share network/IP allowlist details? Also flag: VentureX has an internal SOC review that must run before week 3.

Samir Cho: Yep — I’ll own the API integration and deploy the staging env. I’ll post the test endpoint and sample curl in this thread later. ETA to have stage endpoint by Day 7.

Lena Gomez: I’ll track overall timeline and create the week-by-week milestones in the CS playbook. Putting a calendar placeholder for the weekly sync. Will also log risks in the playbook.

Darren Lee: Heads up — contract shows renewal conversation in 11 months but with a 60-day notice clause. We should capture early value metrics (latency/cost/usage) to reduce churn risk. Suggest adding a pilot KPI: 70% reduction in triaged L2 tickets by month 2.

Asha Patel: Good catch Darren. Adding KPI: "reduction in L2 triage for LLM-generated responses" — target 70% by M2. Also capture baseline before integration.

OnboardBot: Calendar event created: "VentureX Onboarding - Weekly Stand" Thu Apr 4 14:00 PST. Invitees: Asha, Miguel, Priya, Samir, Lena.

Samir Cho: Stage test curl (temporary credentials):
```
curl -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.example/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xstg_test_abc123" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"hello"}'
```

Samir Cho: Note: response has a `request_id` and `latency_ms` fields to capture performance metrics.

Priya Nair: Security owners for VentureX: Tom (customer SOC), me (CS security PM), and Darren (exec sponsor). Tom needs an SSO integration doc and the KMS flow. I’ll send the template today.

Miguel Torres: For enablement: two sessions -> (1) integration walkthrough for devs, (2) ops/runbook for support. Will record and upload to Confluence + share short 5-min clip for execs.

Lena Gomez: Action items I captured so far:
- Samir: stage endpoint + sample curl (Due Day 7)
- Priya: security checklist + SSO doc (Due Day 5)
- Miguel: enablement deck + record sessions (Dates: Apr 8 & Apr 15)
- Asha: baseline metrics capture plan + kickoff summary (Due Day 2)
- Lena: playbook + weekly calendar (Done)

Darren Lee: Risk log: payment terms are net-30; finance flagged that auto-apply of additional capacity requires PO. Add finance touchpoint before scale testing.

Asha Patel: Noted — @Lena can you add a finance checkpoint on Day 10 to confirm PO path? Also who will handle customer success surveys after demo? I'd like a quick CSAT + technical feedback form.

Lena Gomez: Adding finance checkpoint Day 10. I can set up the CSAT form — will make it two questions + optional free text. Link will be posted after demo.

Priya Nair: One more: their SOC wants the pen-test scope by Day 14. We should offer our standard scope doc. @Darren can you confirm if we need to involve legal?

Darren Lee: Legal should be looped if they request contract amendments. For scope sharing, it's standard — no legal needed unless they request contract changes.

Miguel Torres: Quick question — who will run the pilot load? Customer or Redwood? We should agree so we can provision burst capacity if needed.

Samir Cho: We can run a controlled pilot from our side with their traffic replay. Recommend we own the first 2 hours to measure latency; customer runs a longer test.

Asha Patel: OK agreed: Redwood runs initial pilot replay (Day 16), customer-run extended pilot Day 18-19. Add capacity planning note for eng infra.

Lena Gomez: I created the playbook checklist and shared it: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/VX-onboard-playbook (internal link) — will update with assignees.

Asha Patel: Thanks all. Final ask: please react with :thumbsup: once you confirm your items so I can lock dates.

Miguel Torres: :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: :thumbsup:

Samir Cho: :thumbsup:

Lena Gomez: :thumbsup:

Darren Lee: :thumbsup:
